Purpose: Make a passive piezo beep using the Arduino core tone function. This AVR engine uses Timer2 interrupts. Wiring: Passive buzzer: PIN D8. Common GND; use each module’s required supply. Try: Change the frequency from 440 Hz to 880 Hz; compare one octave.
